svg.title: Uno R3 Push Button with Internal Pull-Up

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Use a normally-open momentary switch. Software debounce is still required.

g.desc: Use a normally-open momentary switch. Software debounce is still required.

g.text: The PWR_FLAG only models power supplied by the Uno; it is not a physical part.

g.desc: The PWR_FLAG only models power supplied by the Uno; it is not a physical part.

g.text: KiCad ERC and exact-net checks required; physical wiring is unverified.

g.desc: KiCad ERC and exact-net checks required; physical wiring is unverified.

g.text: Uno R3 is powered through USB. Pressing SW1 connects D2 (PD2) to GND.

g.desc: Uno R3 is powered through USB. Pressing SW1 connects D2 (PD2) to GND.

g.text: The firmware enables the ATmega328P internal pull-up on D2; no external resistor is fitted.

g.desc: The firmware enables the ATmega328P internal pull-up on D2; no external resistor is fitted.

g.text: The open switch reads HIGH and the pressed switch reads LOW.

g.desc: The open switch reads HIGH and the pressed switch reads LOW.
